senses.gloss: (b. h.), Pi. עִוֵּול, עִיוֵּל (denom. of עָוֶל) to act perversely; to do wrong, cheat.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite> <he>המְעַוּוֵל במידות והמשקר וכ׳</he> he who cheats in measuring, and is false in weighing; Mekh. Mishp. s. 13.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:30">Yalk. Num. 765</cite> <he>מה אתה מועל ומשקר וכ׳</he> (read: <cite ref="M02078"><he>מְעַוֵּל</he></cite>) why dost thou cheat and give false weights?; Tanḥ. Balak 12 <he>מה אתה עושה מעולה ומשקר וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:30">ib.</cite> ed. Bab. 16; a. e.
